summary.text: Penni McClammy, listed by Ballotpedia as Patrice McClammy, is a Democratic state representative from Alabama House District 76 who took office in November 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. McClammy is an attorney with a Ph.D. in public policy and administration.

paragraphs.text: McClammy earned a B.A. in political science from Hampton University in 1997, an A.A. in legal studies from Faulkner University in 1999, a J.D. from Faulkner University in 2002, and a Ph.D. in public policy and administration from Florida State University in 2006.
McClammy's career experience includes owning Patrice E. McClammy, Attorney-At-Law, LLC.
McClammy assumed office in the Alabama House on November 17, 2021, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.

In the 2025-2026 session McClammy was assigned to the Financial Services Committee, the House Judiciary Committee, the Military and Veterans' Affairs Committee and the Montgomery County Legislation Committee.
